statement: All three major HBM vendors are now in volume production of HBM4 for NVIDIA, with Samsung moved from qualified to volume shipping.
why: Three qualified HBM4 sources instead of one or two widens the memory supply available for next-generation accelerators and reduces single-supplier risk.

impact.mechanism: Multiple qualified HBM4 suppliers raise available memory bit supply and competitive pressure, removing memory as the limiting input for next-generation GPU builds.

evidence.excerpt: All three major HBM vendors are now in volume production on HBM4 for NVIDIA

confidence.basis: Secondary newsletter citing a Korean trade-press qualification report; no memory-vendor disclosure read directly.

dispersion: No bit-volume or share figures given for the three vendors; qualification status only.
